# Bequest

A disposition of property or money in a will. Supports 8 core types (specific, pecuniary, demonstrative, general, residuary, life_interest, class, debt_forgiveness) and extension types via x-inherit- prefix (e.g. x-inherit-wasiyya, x-inherit-halachic-matanah)

Source: [`v3/bequest.json`](../../v3/bequest.json)

Schema `$id`: `https://openinherit.org/v3/bequest.json`

## Properties

| Property | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `string` (uuid) | yes | Unique identifier for this bequest within the INHERIT document |
| `bequestType` | one of `specific`, `pecuniary`, `demonstrative`, `general`, `residuary`, `life_interest`, `class`, `debt_forgiveness` or `string` | yes | The category of bequest. Core types cover common law estates. Extension types use x-inherit- prefix (e.g. x-inherit-wasiyya, x-inherit-halachic-matanah) |
| `beneficiaryId` | `string` (uuid) | | Reference to the Person.id of the individual beneficiary |
| `beneficiaryIdDisplay` | `string` | | Human-readable display name for the referenced beneficiary |
| `beneficiaryOrganisation` | [BeneficiaryOrganisation](#def-BeneficiaryOrganisation) | | Organisation receiving this bequest, if not an individual |
| `classDefinition` | `string` | | Natural-language definition of the beneficiary class. Required for class bequests. Must be precise enough for executors to identify all members |
| `lifeInterest` | [LifeInterest](#def-LifeInterest) | | Life interest details, required when type is 'life_interest' |
| `amount` | [Money](common/money.md) | | Cash amount for pecuniary and demonstrative bequests, in minor currency units |
| `sharePercentage` | `number` | | Percentage share of the residuary estate or a specified fund |
| `description` | `string` | | Free-text description of the bequest — what is being given |
| `sourceAssetId` | `string` (uuid) | | Reference to the Asset.id from which a demonstrative bequest should be paid |
| `conditions` | array of `object` | | Conditions precedent that must be satisfied before the beneficiary receives this bequest. Each condition has a typed category for machine-readable common patterns, plus a human-readable description |
| `substitutions` | array of [Substitution](#def-Substitution) | | Substitute beneficiaries in case the primary beneficiary cannot receive the gift |
| `hotchpot` | `boolean` | | Whether lifetime gifts (advances) to the beneficiary are brought into account when calculating their share. Common in intestacy and some wills |
| `distributionMethod` | one of `per_capita`, `per_stirpes`, `modified_per_stirpes`, `per_capita_at_each_generation` or `string` | | How the bequest is distributed among multiple beneficiaries |
| `predeceaseRule` | one of `lapse`, `per_stirpes`, `substitution`, `accrual`, `statutory_default` | | What happens if the beneficiary dies before the testator |
| `constrainedBy` | one of `testamentary_freedom`, `customary_rule`, `forced_heirship`, `religious_rule`, `coparcenary_survivorship` | | Which legal principle constrains this bequest, if any |
| `customaryOverride` | `boolean` | | Whether customary or religious law overrides the testator's freedom to dispose of this gift as they wish |
| `postDeathActions` | array of [PostDeathAction](#def-PostDeathAction) | | Post-death actions that modified this bequest — disclaimers, deeds of variation, appropriations |
| `inheritanceResponse` | [InheritanceResponse](#def-InheritanceResponse) | | The beneficiary's formal response to this inheritance, if applicable |
| `hotchpotTransferIds` | array of `string` (uuid) | | References to lifetime transfer IDs that should be brought into account (hotchpot) when calculating this beneficiary's entitlement. Links bequests to prior gifts — if the testator gave the beneficiary £50,000 during their lifetime, this bequest may be reduced accordingly |
| `notes` | `string` | | Free-text notes about this bequest. Use for context, testator intent, or special instructions to executors |
| `visibility` | [Visibility](common/visibility.md) | | |
| `assetIds` | array of `string` (uuid) | | References to Asset.id(s) being bequeathed as individual items. A bequest may reference either assetIds (individual items) or assetCollectionId (entire collection), not both |
| `assetCollectionId` | `string` (uuid) | | Reference to the AssetCollection.id being bequeathed. A bequest may reference either assetIds (individual items) or assetCollectionId (entire collection), not both |
| `propertyIds` | array of `string` (uuid) | | References to Property.id(s) being devised. Links this bequest to specific real property — enables programmatic estate distribution calculation |
| `liabilityIds` | array of `string` (uuid) | | References to Liability.id(s) associated with this bequest. For debt_forgiveness bequests, these are the debts being cancelled. For other types, indicates liabilities attached to the bequeathed asset |
| `insurancePolicyIds` | array of `string` (uuid) | | References to InsurancePolicy.id(s) associated with this bequest. Links life insurance or other policies whose proceeds form part of this gift |
| `charityPurposeRestriction` | `string` | | Restriction on how the charity may use the bequeathed funds — e.g. 'Must be used for cancer research only' |
| `charityNonMergingClause` | `boolean` | | Whether the gift fails if the charity merges with another organisation before distribution |
| `charityReportingRequired` | `boolean` | | Whether the charity is required to report back on how the funds were used |
| `charityGiftAidEligible` | `boolean` | | Whether the bequest has been verified as eligible for Gift Aid. In the UK, estates leaving 10%+ to charity qualify for the reduced 36% IHT rate |
| `charityRegistrationVerifiedAt` | `string` (date-time) | | When the charity's registration was last verified as active |
| `legacyPledge` | `object` | | A legacy pledge commitment tracked before the will is finalised |
| `giftAidRegistrationNumber` | `string` | | Gift Aid registration number for the charity |
| `giftAidVerificationUrl` | `string` (uri) | | URL to verify the Gift Aid registration |
| `giftAidVerifiedAt` | `string` (date-time) | | When Gift Aid registration was last verified |
| `comments` | array of `object` | | Discussion comments on this entity |
| `provenance` | [Provenance](common/provenance.md) | | Consolidated provenance metadata — how this entity was created, by whom, and whether a human has verified it |
| `applicableLaw` | [Jurisdiction](common/jurisdiction.md) | | The jurisdiction whose succession law governs this item. Missing means defaults to estate domicile |
| `powerOfAppointmentId` | `string` (uuid) | | Reference to a PowerOfAppointment.id — indicates this bequest's distribution is subject to a power of appointment |
| `classSubstitution` | `object` | | Substitution rules for class gifts — what happens when a member of the class predeceases the testator |
| `priority` | `integer` | | Explicit priority order within the will. Lower numbers take precedence |
| `clauseReference` | `string` | | The clause number in the will that contains this bequest |
| `executorDirections` | array of `object` | | Administrative directions to the executor regarding this bequest |
| `mentionedAssetIds` | array of `string` (uuid) | | Assets mentioned in this clause for clarity but not limiting scope. For residuary bequests, named for legal certainty while absorbing all unallocated assets |
| `mentionedPropertyIds` | array of `string` (uuid) | | Properties mentioned in this clause for clarity but not limiting scope |
| `precatoryWishes` | array of `object` | | Non-binding wishes expressed by the testator about how the beneficiary should use or treat the bequeathed item |

Also accepts properties whose names match `^x-inherit-[a-z][a-z0-9-]{1,54}$`.

## Definitions

<a id="def-BeneficiaryOrganisation"></a>

### BeneficiaryOrganisation

An organisation that receives a bequest — charity, company, trust, or unincorporated association

| Property | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | `string` | yes | Name of the beneficiary organisation |
| `type` | one of `charity`, `company`, `unincorporated_association`, `trust`, `other` | yes | The legal form of the organisation |
| `registrationNumber` | `string` | | Charity registration number, company number, or other official registration |
| `jurisdiction` | [Jurisdiction](common/jurisdiction.md) | | Jurisdiction where the organisation is registered |

<a id="def-InheritanceResponse"></a>

### InheritanceResponse

The beneficiary's response to the inheritance — acceptance, renunciation, or qualified acceptance. In civil law jurisdictions, acceptance may be required within a time limit

| Property | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `response` | one of `accepted`, `renounced`, `qualified_acceptance`, `pending` | yes | The beneficiary's formal response to the inheritance |
| `responseDate` | `string` (date) | | Date the response was made |
| `responsePersonId` | `string` (uuid) | | Reference to the Person.id of the respondent |
| `responsePersonIdDisplay` | `string` | | Human-readable display name for the referenced response person |
| `courtFiled` | `boolean` | | Whether the response was filed with a court (required in some jurisdictions) |
| `deadlineDate` | `string` (date) | | Statutory deadline for responding (e.g. 3 months in Japan, 4 months in France) |

<a id="def-LifeInterest"></a>

### LifeInterest

Details of a life interest — one person enjoys the asset during their lifetime, then it passes to the remainderman

| Property | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `tenantForLifeId` | `string` (uuid) | yes | Reference to the Person.id who holds the life interest |
| `tenantForLifeIdDisplay` | `string` | | Human-readable display name for the referenced tenant for life |
| `remaindermanId` | `string` (uuid) | | Reference to the Person.id who receives the asset after the life interest ends |
| `remaindermanIdDisplay` | `string` | | Human-readable display name for the referenced remainderman |
| `remaindermanClassDefinition` | `string` | | Natural-language description of the remainderman class if not a named individual |
| `interestType` | one of `use_and_income`, `income_only`, `use_only`, `protective`, `right_of_residence` | yes | The scope of the life interest |

<a id="def-PostDeathAction"></a>

### PostDeathAction

An action taken after death that modifies the bequest — disclaimer, deed of variation, appropriation, or assent

| Property | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `type` | one of `disclaimer`, `deed_of_variation`, `appropriation`, `assent` | yes | The type of post-death action |
| `actionDate` | `string` (date) | | Date the action was taken |
| `description` | `string` | | Description of the action taken |
| `documentId` | `string` (uuid) | | Reference to the Document entity recording this action |
| `variationDetails` | `object` | | Details of a deed of variation — who redirected what to whom |

<a id="def-Substitution"></a>

### Substitution

A substitute beneficiary who receives the bequest if the primary beneficiary cannot (e.g. predeceases the testator)

| Property | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `beneficiaryId` | `string` (uuid) | | Reference to the Person.id of the substitute beneficiary |
| `beneficiaryIdDisplay` | `string` | | Human-readable display name for the referenced beneficiary |
| `classDefinition` | `string` | | Natural-language description of the substitute class |
| `beneficiaryOrganisation` | [BeneficiaryOrganisation](#def-BeneficiaryOrganisation) | | Substitute organisation if the substitution is to a charity or company |
| `condition` | `string` | | The condition that triggers this substitution |
| `perStirpes` | `boolean` | | Whether the substitution is per stirpes — passing to the deceased beneficiary's descendants by representation |
